remove.affectedAgents: {{providerName}} models used by {{agents}} will be unavailable until it is added again.
remove.credentialsNotice: Its API key and headers will be deleted from config.json.

refresh.delisted: {{providerName}} no longer lists {{models}}. They stay until you remove them.
refresh.delistedAgents: Used by {{agents}}: pick another model for them.

models.delisted: {{providerName}} no longer lists {{modelName}}; it may stop working. Select another model.

errors.unavailable: The host has no model services.
errors.configChanged: The config was changed elsewhere and has been read again. Take a look, then save once more.
errors.invalidProviderId: The name cannot be empty or too long.
errors.invalidConfig: The base URL is not valid.
errors.invalidDefaultModel: The default model is not among the configured models.
errors.invalidNetwork: The proxy address is not valid.
errors.invalidSavedConfig: config.json cannot be read. Fix the file first.

editor.description: Saved to config.json; the next request uses it.
editor.name: Name
editor.empty: No providers yet. Add one to give the host something to run.
editor.unsaved: This form has changes that would be lost.
editor.headersHint: A header with no name is not written to config.json.
editor.chatCompletionsHint: Uses /chat/completions; supports OpenAI API keys and compatible services.
editor.responsesHint: Uses /responses; supports OpenAI API keys and compatible services.
editor.baseUrlHint: Editable for proxies or gateways. The OpenAI API URL is https://api.openai.com/v1.
editor.nativeCodex: Sign in to and manage Codex subscriptions in the Accounts section of Model providers; no provider entry is needed.
editor.legacyCodex: Legacy Codex config (not migrated). Use Accounts for subscriptions; config and model references are unchanged.

discovery.hint: Uses the current URL, key and headers. Selection is a preview until you save. Existing models are never overwritten; missing models can be added manually.
discovery.empty: No usable models returned. Retry or add a model manually.
discovery.noMatches: No matching models. You can add one manually.
discovery.stale: Connection settings changed. Get the model list again. Previous preview selections were cleared; existing and manually added models are kept.
discovery.invalidConnection: Use an HTTP(S) base URL without credentials or query parameters.
discovery.unsupported: This provider type does not publish a model list. Use existing models or configure a custom provider manually.
discovery.network: Cannot reach the model endpoint: {{reason}}. Check the URL, network, key and headers, then retry.
discovery.response: The model endpoint returned an invalid format: expected JSON with a data array. Check the URL and retry.
discovery.timeout: Getting the model list timed out. Check the network and retry.
discovery.http: The model endpoint returned HTTP {{status}}. Check the URL, key, headers and access permissions, then retry.
discovery.configChanged: Configuration changed elsewhere. Go back and reopen this form before fetching again.
discovery.modelsDevHint: From models.dev; no key needed. Selection is a preview until you save. Refresh models later to pick up new ones.

metadata.hint: Fill missing metadata for exact official model matches in this form from models.dev; not an account model list. Manual values take priority. Save to apply.
metadata.failed: Public model metadata failed: {{reason}}. You can still add or save models manually.
metadata.ready: Matched public metadata for {{count}} models. Existing values are unchanged; save to apply.
metadata.empty: No reliable public metadata match. Models are unchanged and can still be edited manually.
